subject.title: [Feature] Allow configuring Gemini safety settings in OpenClaw

question: Should OpenClaw expose a first-class Gemini safety-settings config knob, and if so what schema, categories, thresholds, and precedence should it support?
rationale: This is a new safety-affecting provider config surface; automation should not choose whether users may tune Gemini safety filters or which upstream categories and thresholds become public contract.

options.title: Approve a narrow Google setting
options.body: Add a strict Google-scoped `models.providers.*.safetySettings` or equivalent contract with documented categories, thresholds, request precedence, and tests.

options.title: Keep upstream defaults
options.body: Decline the config surface for now and keep Gemini safety behavior on provider defaults to avoid adding a safety-affecting knob.

options.title: Design a broader provider-settings seam
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define a general provider-specific request-settings API that can cover Google and future provider-owned controls.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow Google setting
recommendation.body: Add a strict Google-scoped `models.providers.*.safetySettings` or equivalent contract with documented categories, thresholds, request precedence, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior issue routing and recent Google provider/config history make this the best available owner for the product-direction choice.
